content.short: Mantium Wallet is a non-custodial iOS wallet for Cardano with mobile NFT minting and dApp access tools.
content.description: Mantium Wallet is a feature-rich, non-custodial mobile wallet specifically designed for the iOS ecosystem to provide direct access to the Cardano blockchain. Beyond standard ADA and token management, the wallet offers a unique utility by enabling users to mint NFTs directly from their iPhone camera or video library. With an integrated DApp connector and a focus on intuitive design, Mantium simplifies the process of interacting with marketplaces and DeFi protocols. It is a vital tool for creators and collectors looking for a mobile-first blockchain experience.
